name: Polygon Embedding via Dual Depth Buffers
definition: A technique to insert polygon objects pixel-by-pixel between volume samples along rays by using two depth buffers (D0, D1) to define the depth range [D0, D1) for volume sampling, blending the volume result behind the polygon image.
summary: Polygon Embedding via Dual Depth Buffers integrates polygonal geometry into volume rendering by using two depth buffers to define sampling intervals, avoiding complex scene graph traversal.
